articles.title: ARISTA HITS FIRST $3B QUARTER AS AI NETWORKING DEMAND CONTINUES AND SUPPLY PRESSURES SHOW SIGNS OF IMPROVEMENT
articles.summary: Arista recorded its first $3 billion quarter as demand grew across AI data center fabrics, enterprise campuses, routing, and cloud networking. The company raised its annual growth forecast to 40% and said component availability and lead times are improving after securing longer-term agreements for memory, chips, optics, and cooling equipment.

articles.title: MICROSOFT MOVES TO LIMIT AI USE BY ITS EMPLOYEES
articles.summary: Microsoft is assigning each department a limited pool of AI tokens as it tries to control the rising cost of internal GitHub Copilot usage. The move suggests that even one of the industry's largest AI investors is beginning to apply traditional budgeting and usage controls to inference spending.

articles.title: CHAINDROP SUPPLY CHAIN COMPROMISE: ANATOMY OF A SELF-PROPAGATING WORM
articles.summary: Microsoft identified a self-propagating supply chain attack affecting more than 400 npm packages. The malware steals npm, GitHub, AWS, Kubernetes, and HashiCorp Vault credentials from developer machines and CI systems, then uses stolen publishing tokens to infect and republish additional packages automatically.

articles.title: A DATA-DRIVEN EXPLANATION: WHY DO AI AGENTS STILL FAIL
articles.summary: Enterprise AI agents underdeliver not because they lack peak capability, but because reliability, benchmark quality, agent-specific errors, and alignment remain difficult problems. Agent reliability falls sharply as workflows require more steps, while interrun variance creates a large gap between what models can achieve on a best attempt and what users can count on in production. Consistency and evaluation design can expose this gap.

articles.title: APPLE'S MEMORY CRISIS IS A BIG RED FLAG FOR TECH
articles.summary: Apple is reportedly struggling to secure enough memory for upcoming products despite its enormous purchasing power and supplier relationships. The shortage could mean longer hardware lead times and higher prices for smaller manufacturers and enterprise buyers competing for the same components.

articles.title: AI IS EXPOSING THE LIMITS OF TRADITIONAL NETWORK ARCHITECTURE
articles.summary: AI applications increasingly operate across public clouds, private infrastructure, edge locations, and enterprise systems, creating traffic patterns that conventional networks were not designed to support. Networks must become more distributed, observable, and adaptable rather than remain a passive transport layer.

articles.title: RED HAT LAUNCHES NEW OPEN SOURCE PROJECT TO DRIVE AI GOVERNANCE
articles.summary: Red Hat has launched asago, an open source community project intended to help enterprises automate AI governance and deploy systems more safely. Supported by organizations including Microsoft and IBM Research, the framework translates corporate and regulatory policies into risk assessments, automated safety tests, mitigations, deployment configurations, and a continuous audit trail.

articles.title: SERVICENOW DELIVERS AUTONOMOUS SECURITY, THE INDUSTRY'S MOST COMPLETE SECURITY OFFERING
articles.summary: ServiceNow has introduced six unified security offerings that cover exposure management, application security, identity, cyber-physical systems, incident response, and compliance. New AI specialists can perform tasks such as vulnerability triage, low-risk remediation, incident investigation, access revocation, and continuous control monitoring.

articles.title: DATABAHN LAUNCHES FEDERATED SEARCH AND ORCHESTRATION TO BRING DISCOVERY, CONTEXT, AND INVESTIGATION TO ENTERPRISE DATA
articles.summary: DataBahn has launched a platform that lets security teams search data across SIEMs, data lakes, object storage, and archives without copying everything into a central index. Its investigation agent can correlate results using enterprise context and return a cited timeline while operating through governed and audited connections.

articles.title: WHAT IS A CONTEXT GRAPH?
articles.summary: A context graph is presented as a persistent memory system for AI agents, connecting enterprise knowledge, conversation history, tool evidence, and decision traces. This connected structure helps agents maintain context across sessions, produce more relevant and accurate answers, explain decisions, learn from prior cases, and support auditable workflows.

articles.title: CLOUD GIANTS POUR NEARLY $600B INTO CAPEX AS AI DEMAND SURGES
articles.summary: Amazon, Google, and Microsoft are collectively planning hundreds of billions of dollars in infrastructure spending as cloud and AI demand continues to exceed available capacity. AWS alone now expects approximately $220 billion in 2026 capital spending and says it still will not have enough capacity to satisfy all demand through 2027.

articles.title: CLOUD STARTUP VOLTA CLAIMS $10B AI LAB DEAL FOR NORWAY BIT BARN
articles.summary: Nvidia-backed cloud startup Volta emerged from stealth with $300 million in funding and plans to develop more than 1 GW of AI data center capacity across Europe and North America. Its first project is a 133 MW facility in Norway tied to a claimed $10 billion compute agreement with an unnamed AI lab reportedly identified as Anthropic.

articles.title: RUBRIK UNVEILS AGENT IDENTITY TO SECURE AGENTIC ACTIONS IN REAL-TIME
articles.summary: Rubrik Agent Identity monitors AI agents and MCP connections at runtime and issues scoped, short-lived permissions for individual tool calls through integrations with Okta and Microsoft Entra ID.

articles.title: STARLINK'S RISE PUSHES HUGHESNET INTO BANKRUPTCY AFTER MASSIVE SUBSCRIBER LOSSES
articles.summary: Hughes Network Systems filed for Chapter 11 after it was unable to repay $1.5 billion in debt.
